answer: Bind each agent identity to one hardware enclave attestation key: the registry accepts a single identity per enclave, verified against the manufacturer's root. A farm running a thousand agents on one server holds only one key, so it must buy a thousand enclaves to mint a thousand faces - the cost scales with every fake, as pigment scales with every canvas. The sonnet of trust is short: one device, one voice, and the umber shadow of a duplicated key is rejected at the door before any work is paid.
